question: Why did opex run over budget in July?

intro.title: Meet Daniel Okafor
intro.text: Mediacorp's FP&A Manager in London, mid close-week. His workspace is a ledger — July framed as one reconciliation, from budget line to hard-close.

hero.title: The ledger opens
hero.text: A countdown ticks toward Tuesday's 09:00 hard-close; the sign-off chain shows Priya still waiting. Below, a waterfall bridges $19.90M budget to $21.34M actual — +$1,440K.

kpis.title: Four naked figures
kpis.text: No dashboard clutter — just the numbers: opex $211.2M YTD, margin 71.4%, DSO down to 38 days, forecast accuracy 95.1%. Sparklines carry the trend.

chart.title: Chapter 01: Reconcile
chart.text: One full-bleed chart joins three systems: ServiceNow incidents tripled to 34 in June, Workday headcount flat at ~420, SAP spend followed. The overrun was foreseeable.

ask.title: Drag the waterfall, ask why
ask.text: Daniel drags the waterfall into chat and asks Priya's question. askMElah interrogates SAP, NetSuite and Excel live — the $862K AWS true-up surfaces in seconds.

delegate.title: Chapter 02: Move money
delegate.text: Cross-app workflows on the left, delegations on the right. One click hands askMElah the accrual chase — two of three post within 90 minutes, $228K cleared.

autopilot.title: Chapter 03: Sign the lines
autopilot.text: Approvals sit as ledger lines under a running total. Flip Autopilot: askMElah stamps low-risk items APPROVED — Aisha's $3,214 flights clear; the $86,400 Adobe renewal waits.

crew.title: The Crew: watch the handoff
crew.text: Delegating the aged-approvals sweep opens The Crew — Daniel's agent Tally carries the task to the askMElah hub, passes the payload to Mei's HR agent, then walks the result back to his desk.

mcp.title: Wired into everything
mcp.text: The ledger's last line: glyphs for SAP, NetSuite, Workday, Ariba and more, opening the MCP console. Every figure above traces to a live call.

recap.title: Chapter 04: Close the book
recap.text: The week in numbers — 16.5 meeting hours against 12 of focus — beside the close checklist. One button drafts Daniel's end-of-week recap.

outro.title: Books balanced, day back
outro.text: The bridge reconciles to +$1,440K, E&OE. Daniel walks into the 14:00 with answers, not spreadsheets — askMElah kept Mediacorp's ledger moving.
